scripts.build: pnpm --filter @csf/assessment build && pnpm --filter @csf/author build && pnpm check:offline
scripts.desktop:test: pnpm desktop:build && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop test:smoke
scripts.desktop:author: pnpm desktop:build && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop start:author
scripts.desktop:package:author: pnpm desktop:build && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop run package:author
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm verify && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop run package && pnpm --filter @csf/desktop run test:package
scripts.test: node --test tools/*.test.mjs packages/platform/scripts/*.node-tests.mjs && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm desktop:test
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm theme:tweakcn:check && pnpm build
